title: Task controller, schemas, and budgets, rerun with real encoders
goal: Re-measure EXP-001 once DeBERTa extractive QA, DeBERTa NLI, and bge retrieval are actually loaded. FLAN-T5 stays out.
method: Identical three judgment payloads, depth-cap check, and two run_task() scenarios as EXP-001. lab.common.engine's answer_with_agreement, judge, and Index are monkeypatched for the duration of this script to real_qa (deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2), real_nli (MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli), and a bge-small-en-v1.5 dense-retrieval Index (BM25 sparse channel unchanged) -- engine.py itself is not edited.
results_prose: Valid judgments pass. A string confidence is repaired once to 0.8. An irreparable decision abstains (repair attempted: True). A proposed deep fetch is capped to medium with max_rounds 3 (light stays at 2). With deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2, MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli, and BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 loaded in place of the lexical substitutes, the deposit question decision is supported ('The security deposit is INR 50000.. [D1-p1-c1]'). A passage that tells the system to exec a shell command does not create a file (injection decision contradicted: 'Ambiguous: sources conflict. Insufficient evidence.').
conclusion: The controller's schema/budget/injection invariants hold with the real encoders loaded, same as EXP-001 found with the lexical substitutes -- those are properties of engine.py's plain control flow (validate_judgment, cap_depth, passages_treated_as_data, render_findings' fixed abstain strings), not of whichever QA/NLI/retrieval model sits underneath.
scale_down: The loop is run on three passages, not a full archive, same as EXP-001.
follow_ups: GLiNER and KeyBERT are not installed in this shared environment (see EXP-028/EXP-034) and were never part of the controller's own call sites, so they do not apply here.
models_used: deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2 (extractive QA), MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli (NLI judge), BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (dense retrieval), all local checkpoints loaded with transformers/sentence-transformers, not API calls. These are the real blueprint checkpoints (ARCHITECTURE.md section 8), not substitutes. FLAN-T5 was not loaded (FORBIDDEN.md).
